pages.text: $(bold)Threat level:$() severe$(br2)Former ORSA staff, civilians, anyone who froze and did not stay dead. Three variants.$(br2)$(italic)HR asked us to stop calling them colleagues. Denied: the paperwork is still valid.$()

pages.title: Variant A: Hunter
pages.text: Intelligent stalkers. Rare, but they invade bases.$(li)Opens and breaks wooden doors$(li)Puts out lit Thermal Heaters$(li)Breaks torches and lights$(li)Sees through invisibility
$(bold)Drops:$() Remnant Ember, Tattered Clothing Scrap, ORSA ID Badge (rare)

$(bold)Counters:$()$(li)Seal entrances with blocks, not doors$(li)Hide backup heaters$(li)$(l:heating/frost_ward_torch)Frost Ward Torches$(/l) cannot be broken$(li)Fire and Acheronite weapons work$(br2)$(italic)Do not read the ID badges. You might know the name.$()

pages.title: Variant B: Mimic
pages.text: Looks like a still, watching shadow figure. Within 16 blocks it copies your movement, then attacks.$(li)First sprint hit deals bonus damage$(li)Strafes instead of trading blows$(li)Retreats to darkness when hurt$(li)Resets after 15s out of sight
$(bold)Counters:$()$(li)Fire: +50% damage$(li)A shadow figure still there after 10s is not one$(li)Shadows have no health bar$(br2)$(bold)Drops:$() Tattered Clothing Scrap, Mirrored Fragment (rare)
$(italic)Agent Torres reported a shadow figure that followed her for three minutes before attacking. Torres survived. Her partner, who she assumed was the figure, did not.$()

pages.title: Variant C: Architect
pages.text: $(bold)Behavior:$() The rarest and most dangerous variant. The Architect doesn't just attack — it dismantles. It observes your base from a distance, identifies weak points, then systematically mines through walls with the correct tool.

$(li)Watches from 30-40 blocks before approaching$(li)Breaks through player-built walls with visible cracks$(li)Scaffolds over Acheronite walls using packed ice$(li)Switches tools: pickaxe for stone, axe for wood, shovel for dirt$(li)Drinks healing potions when wounded

$(li)Blocks doorways with ice to cut off escape$(li)Retreats behind ice walls when low on health$(br2)$(bold)Counter Strategies:$()$(br)$(li)Acheronite Block walls cannot be broken — force it to scaffold$(li)Fire deals 1.5x damage

$(li)Interrupt its healing by pressing the attack$(li)Build layered defenses — it must choose between breaking and climbing$(br2)$(bold)Drops:$() $(l:orsa_rd/soul_harvesting)Architect Soul$(/l) (50%), $(item)Surveyor Lens$() (18%), $(item)Architect Mask$() (2.5%), $(item)Tattered Clothing Scrap$()

$(italic)ORSA structural assessment: Subject dismantled a reinforced shelter in 4 minutes. Used appropriate tools for each material. Paused to build cover when fired upon. This was not instinct. This was engineering.$()
